raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (txn dates 2026-01-16) was delivered with amount_unit='USD_CENTS', so the amounts are in cents even though currency says USD. The silver step ignores amount_unit and loads them as dollars, inflating the mean to 3770.88 against a median of 43.05. The fix is to divide by 100 for USD_CENTS rows; the gold tables rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CASE WHEN amount_unit = 'USD_CENTS' THEN CAST(ROUND(amount / 100.0, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) ELSE CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) END AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
